visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a shot of the restaurant's grand entrance under a large circular 'WU TONG' sign. Two individuals, one in orange and one in black, are seen from behind walking into the glass doors. Inside, the camera pans across elegant dining booths featuring floral wallpaper, warm pendant lighting, and semi-circular architectural arches. (2) A hand places a festive yellow party hat next to illuminated 'HBD' letters. A slice of tiramisu cake is shown closely on a spoon. The scene shifts to a long buffet counter overflowing with fresh green vegetables, mushrooms, and sliced fruit. Hands are shown serving fluffy white rice and drizzling a thick, orange-red sauce over translucent noodles. (3) A ladle dips into a split pot containing creamy white and spicy red broths, scooping up cubes of duck blood and tofu. A tall, three-tiered metal stand holding plates of marbled raw beef and pork is presented. Close-up shots capture a slice of beef being cooked in the bubbling soup, followed by a dish of crispy chicken wings garnished with celery. (4) A unique dish involving Century egg and seafood paste is prepared and served. Crispy shrimp toast topped with black sesame is dipped into the red broth. Later, rice and whisked eggs are added to the leftover soup to create a rich congee, which is served in a bowl topped with succulent shrimp and glistening salmon roe. (5) A decadent dessert bowl featuring caramelized bananas, coconut milk snow ice, and toppings is showcased with a close-up spooning action. The video concludes with a wide view of an empty, well-lit dining area, before displaying the restaurant's logo and address information on screen as the narrators sign off.
